decisions.task_outcome: Discover login and create an Account
evidence: report.json links and actual navigation responses
decisions.finding: Two explicit Korean actions are visible together; filled login and outlined create-account separate primary/secondary tasks without hiding registration. Landing copy explains that no Company association is required to create an Account. No payroll/business identifiers or false available workspace actions appear.
decisions.limit: Both destination pages intentionally return503 in this no-database smoke; successful Account completion is not proven.

decisions.task_outcome: Understand that Account entry is temporarily unavailable
decisions.finding: Unavailable pages plainly say the Account cannot currently be checked and offer Retry plus Start screen. They show neither success nor active Account data and keep the same visual language.

Registration intent should remain the recovery destination, or the label should explicitly describe a different destination, before the complete registration journey is accepted.
